summary: o-dd82f90b29916621 (g0001): the old harness cannot print a constructed array at the depth limit, but the delegated build configuration is missing, so necessity is unknown.
missing_information: The delegated build configuration is needed to establish the effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT and the library linked into this fuzz target.

assessment.necessity_reason: Under the header default, a constructed array can reach the new print rejection, while the old harness prints only successfully parsed trees. The supplied build entry delegates to an unread script, so the effective configuration and build path are not established.

before.requirement: Reach an array-printer depth rejection for a constructed array at CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
before.reason: The complete old array printer has no depth rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the array printer's failure for a constructed array whose print depth reaches CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The new guard returns failure at the limit. The parser uses the same limit, and the harness prints only after parsing succeeds. Whether that limit is reachable under the delegated build configuration remains unverified.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array parsing rejects a node when its depth reaches the same limit.
Object parsing also blocks a mixed container tree at that depth.
Defines the nesting-limit default when it is not overridden.
The public constructor creates array nodes.
The public append operation can connect those nodes into a tree.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The build entry delegates to the unsupplied fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh script.

assessment.comparison_reason: g0001 adds the depth rejection; the old printer lacks it. The old harness has no construction route, but the configured limit and build path must be confirmed before the after-side obligation is established.
